module rtlpp_03532(
  input aclk,
  input aresetn,
  input [31:0]s_axi_awaddr,
  input [2:0]s_axi_awprot,
  input [0:0]s_axi_awvalid,
  output [0:0]s_axi_awready,
  input [31:0]s_axi_wdata,
  input [3:0]s_axi_wstrb,
  input [0:0]s_axi_wvalid,
  output [0:0]s_axi_wready,
  output [1:0]s_axi_bresp,
  output [0:0]s_axi_bvalid,
  input [0:0]s_axi_bready,
  input [31:0]s_axi_araddr,
  input [2:0]s_axi_arprot,
  input [0:0]s_axi_arvalid,
  output [0:0]s_axi_arready,
  output [31:0]s_axi_rdata,
  output [1:0]s_axi_rresp,
  output [0:0]s_axi_rvalid,
  input [0:0]s_axi_rready,
  output [63:0]m_axi_awaddr,
  output [5:0]m_axi_awprot,
  output [1:0]m_axi_awvalid,
  input  [1:0]m_axi_awready,
  output [63:0]m_axi_wdata,
  output [7:0]m_axi_wstrb,
  output [1:0]m_axi_wvalid,
  input  [1:0]m_axi_wready,
  input  [3:0]m_axi_bresp,
  input  [1:0]m_axi_bvalid,
  output [1:0]m_axi_bready,
  output [63:0]m_axi_araddr,
  output [5:0]m_axi_arprot,
  output [1:0]m_axi_arvalid,
  input  [1:0]m_axi_arready,
  input  [63:0]m_axi_rdata,
  input  [3:0]m_axi_rresp,
  input  [1:0]m_axi_rvalid,
  output [1:0]m_axi_rready
);
  // Register and wire declarations
  reg [63:0] m_axi_awaddr_reg;
  reg [5:0] m_axi_awprot_reg;
  reg [1:0] m_axi_awvalid_reg;
  reg [63:0] m_axi_wdata_reg;
  reg [7:0] m_axi_wstrb_reg;
  reg [1:0] m_axi_wvalid_reg;
  reg [1:0] m_axi_bready_reg;
  reg [63:0] m_axi_araddr_reg;
  reg [5:0] m_axi_arprot_reg;
  reg [1:0] m_axi_arvalid_reg;
  reg [1:0] m_axi_rready_reg;
  reg [0:0] s_axi_awready_reg;
  reg [0:0] s_axi_wready_reg;
  reg [1:0] s_axi_bresp_reg;
  reg [0:0] s_axi_bvalid_reg;
  reg [0:0] s_axi_arready_reg;
  reg [31:0] s_axi_rdata_reg;
  reg [1:0] s_axi_rresp_reg;
  reg [0:0] s_axi_rvalid_reg;

  assign m_axi_awaddr = m_axi_awaddr_reg;
  assign m_axi_awprot = m_axi_awprot_reg;
  assign m_axi_awvalid = m_axi_awvalid_reg;
  assign m_axi_wdata = m_axi_wdata_reg;
  assign m_axi_wstrb = m_axi_wstrb_reg;
  assign m_axi_wvalid = m_axi_wvalid_reg;
  assign m_axi_bready = m_axi_bready_reg;
  assign m_axi_araddr = m_axi_araddr_reg;
  assign m_axi_arprot = m_axi_arprot_reg;
  assign m_axi_arvalid = m_axi_arvalid_reg;
  assign m_axi_rready = m_axi_rready_reg;
  assign s_axi_awready = s_axi_awready_reg;
  assign s_axi_wready = s_axi_wready_reg;
  assign s_axi_bresp = s_axi_bresp_reg;
  assign s_axi_bvalid = s_axi_bvalid_reg;
  assign s_axi_arready = s_axi_arready_reg;
  assign s_axi_rdata = s_axi_rdata_reg;
  assign s_axi_rresp = s_axi_rresp_reg;
  assign s_axi_rvalid = s_axi_rvalid_reg;

  // The core logic for AXI crossbar
  always @(posedge aclk) begin
    if (!aresetn) begin
      m_axi_awaddr_reg <= 64'b0;
      m_axi_awprot_reg <= 6'b0;
      m_axi_awvalid_reg <= 2'b0;
      m_axi_wdata_reg <= 64'b0;
      m_axi_wstrb_reg <= 8'b0;
      m_axi_wvalid_reg <= 2'b0;
      m_axi_bready_reg <= 2'b0;
      m_axi_araddr_reg <= 64'b0;
      m_axi_arprot_reg <= 6'b0;
      m_axi_arvalid_reg <= 2'b0;
      m_axi_rready_reg <= 2'b0;
      s_axi_awready_reg <= 0;
      s_axi_wready_reg <= 0;
      s_axi_bresp_reg <= 2'b0;
      s_axi_bvalid_reg <= 0;
      s_axi_arready_reg <= 0;
      s_axi_rdata_reg <= 32'b0;
      s_axi_rresp_reg <= 2'b0;
      s_axi_rvalid_reg <= 0;
    end else begin
      // Stub logic to set ready and valid signals and forwarding addresses/data
      s_axi_awready_reg <= 1;
      s_axi_wready_reg <= 1;
      s_axi_bresp_reg <= 2'b0;
      s_axi_bvalid_reg <= s_axi_awvalid & s_axi_wvalid;
      s_axi_arready_reg <= 1;
      s_axi_rresp_reg <= 2'b0;
      s_axi_rvalid_reg <= s_axi_arvalid;
      s_axi_rdata_reg <= s_axi_araddr; // Just loopback for this implementation
      m_axi_awaddr_reg <= {s_axi_awaddr, s_axi_awaddr};
      m_axi_awprot_reg <= {s_axi_awprot, s_axi_awprot};
      m_axi_awvalid_reg <= {s_axi_awvalid, s_axi_awvalid};
      m_axi_wdata_reg <= {s_axi_wdata, s_axi_wdata};
      m_axi_wstrb_reg <= {s_axi_wstrb, s_axi_wstrb};
      m_axi_wvalid_reg <= {s_axi_wvalid, s_axi_wvalid};
      m_axi_bready_reg <= {s_axi_bready, s_axi_bready};
      m_axi_araddr_reg <= {s_axi_araddr, s_axi_araddr};
      m_axi_arprot_reg <= {s_axi_arprot, s_axi_arprot};
      m_axi_arvalid_reg <= {s_axi_arvalid, s_axi_arvalid};
      m_axi_rready_reg <= {s_axi_rready, s_axi_rready};
    end
  end

endmodule
